question: Should maintainers port this conflicting replacement PR to current main and accept focused runner/Codex proof for the Codex lane-release fix, or require live wedge proof before merge?
rationale: The code path is a valid bug-fix candidate, but the current head conflicts with newer abort handling and the remaining decision is proof sufficiency and session/message overlap risk rather than a discrete line-level defect.

options.title: Port And Accept Focused Proof
options.body: Refresh the branch on current main, preserve current abort semantics, rerun focused and required checks, and accept the runner/Codex regression proof for this bug slice.

options.title: Require Live Wedge Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a live or Crabbox Codex app-server wedge demonstrates that late cleanup does not corrupt session state or channel-visible delivery.

options.title: Pause Or Replace
options.body: Close or replace this branch if maintainers prefer to fold Codex lane-release into a broader current-main recovery effort.

recommendation.title: Port And Accept Focused Proof
